nodes.label: Linear Design System
nodes.rationale: Single type family across all weights; a four-step dark surface ladder plus hairline borders replaces drop-shadow elevation entirely; positive-tracked eyebrow labels act as taxonomy against negative-tracked display type.

nodes.label: Surface-Ladder Elevation Principle
nodes.rationale: Depth communicated via a stepped surface-luminance ladder (canvas -> surface-1 through surface-4) plus hairline borders, resisting drop shadows almost entirely on a dark canvas. Cited by SKILL.md as the exemplar reasoning behind 'why does Linear resist drop shadows?'.

hyperedges.label: Dark Canvas, No-Shadow Developer Brand Pattern
